platform: CFUV 101.9 FM Digital Music Director Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CFUV accepts digital submissions at music@cfuv.ca. A release must contain at least three unique tracks, use MP3 files at a minimum of 320 kbps and be delivered through a downloadable link. A human must confirm international eligibility, prepare a stable download package, include a proper track list and useful one-page biography, and send manually. Physical submissions are not authorized for non-local artists. Stop if any CAPTCHA, login, payment or new restriction appears.

platform: CHSR-FM 97.9 Digital and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CHSR accepts all genres, with digital MP3 at a minimum of 320 kbps through a download link or email attachment, plus authorized CDs, LPs and cassettes. The Music Director route is published in human-readable obfuscated form and the guideline is marked last updated March 2023, although the station is active and still links it. A human must open the first-party page, manually use the displayed role route, confirm the instructions remain current, include a clear track list plus artist, genre, location and contact information, and send manually. Do not use the adjacent sessions, PSA or general-contact routes as substitutes.
